I can't confirm the date. I have no web search here, and I don't have a reliable record of this award. The team note's two candidates, December 17, 2015 and March 21, 2014, are unsourced, and the reasoning given for March 2014 contradicts itself because it ties the award to a December National Day. A Bhutanese government announcement or a dated news report of the award would settle it.
